sections.title: Three rules that win the fight
sections.callout: Leave the frontal line first; attack during the long axe recovery.
calloutDetail: Circle at medium range, clear ranged mercenaries before the arena becomes crowded, and do not retreat along the red execution line.

answers.label: Prepare
answers.text: Bring physical mitigation, life, movement speed and enough fire resistance for the arena pressure.

answers.label: React
answers.text: Move sideways on a committed overhead or red-line tell, then use one complete damage rotation.

answers.label: Recover
answers.text: If adds and ground effects overlap, reset to clean ground instead of forcing damage.

items.label: Physical mitigation and life
checks: Most direct weapon hits are physical and can remove a large portion of a campaign health pool.
items.why: Most direct weapon hits are physical and can remove a large portion of a campaign health pool.
items.fix: Upgrade body armour, add life on flexible rares, and do not trade survival for a small damage roll.

items.label: Fire resistance
checks: Burning ground and fire pressure can overlap with the boss and his mercenaries.
items.why: Burning ground and fire pressure can overlap with the boss and his mercenaries.
items.fix: Use a temporary fire-resistance ring or charm if the arena effects are the repeated cause of death.

items.label: Movement speed
checks: Sideways movement is the clean answer to the long frontal line and overhead attacks.
items.why: Sideways movement is the clean answer to the long frontal line and overhead attacks.
items.fix: Use movement-speed boots and leave space between the character and the arena edge.

items.label: Add control
checks: Ranged mercenaries can make a safe boss opening dangerous.
items.why: Ranged mercenaries can make a safe boss opening dangerous.
items.fix: Keep an area skill or fast clear link ready; kill ranged adds before resuming the boss rotation.

items.label: Sustainable single target
checks: The fight punishes long stationary casts and attacks.
items.why: The fight punishes long stationary casts and attacks.
items.fix: Use a shorter repeatable rotation and remove supports whose cost cannot be sustained.

phases.label: Opening exchange
phases.trigger: The Executioner enters with the arena clear.
objectives: Learn the overhead and sweeping axe timings.
Fight at medium range with a free lateral path.
Use the recovery after a committed slam.
notes: Do not back straight away from long frontal attacks; move to the side or cross behind after the target locks.

phases.label: Mercenary pressure
phases.trigger: The boss calls or is joined by additional attackers.
objectives: Remove ranged mercenaries that block movement.
Keep the boss visible while clearing adds.
Move out of fire or persistent ground before attacking.
notes: The boss does not become safe because adds appeared. Use a short area clear and return attention to the axe telegraph.

phases.label: Low-health finish
phases.trigger: Attack cadence and arena clutter leave fewer clean windows.
objectives: Preserve one flask charge and a movement route.
Take one safe rotation after each committed attack.
Do not race the final health bar.
notes: Most late deaths come from greed: one extra attack turns a solved telegraph into a hit.

attacks.name: Overhead axe slam
telegraph: Raises the axe with a visible pause before bringing it down in front.
responses: Move to the side or pass behind after the aim commits, then use the recovery window.
commonMistakes: Rolling early and allowing the boss to re-aim.

attacks.name: Straight-line execution strike
telegraph: The boss and attack line show a strong red commitment directly ahead.
responses: Leave the frontal lane laterally; do not retreat along the line.
commonMistakes: Continuing a long cast because the line appears narrow.

attacks.name: Wide axe sweep
telegraph: The weapon pulls to one side before a broad horizontal swing.
responses: Create distance or roll through to the rear after the swing direction is clear.
commonMistakes: Standing at the boss's hip without enough movement space.

attacks.name: Summoned mercenaries
telegraph: Additional attackers enter and ranged projectiles begin crossing the arena.
responses: Kill ranged adds first while circling so the boss remains in view.
commonMistakes: Chasing a distant add and losing sight of the boss wind-up.

attacks.name: Fire and burning ground pressure
telegraph: Fire effects remain on or cross part of the arena floor.
responses: Relocate before beginning the next damage rotation; use clean ground as the priority.
commonMistakes: Rolling out of the axe into persistent fire and staying there.

types.label: Physical
mitigation: High life, armour or evasion and side-rear positioning.
Do not stand inside the frontal weapon line.
notes: The overhead slam, red-line strike and wide sweep are all physical.

types.label: Fire
mitigation: Fire resistance helps when ground effects and mercenaries overlap.
Step off burning ground before committing to a cast.
notes: Burning ground and mercenary fire are the secondary pressure.

sections.title: Positioning and damage windows
paragraphs: Medium range makes the overhead and red-line tells easier to read without forcing the boss to spend the fight walking. Keep circling around open floor rather than backing into the arena wall.

Melee characters should cross to the rear after the attack locks, use one short combo, and leave before the next sweep. Ranged characters still need to move; distance alone does not solve the straight-line strike or add projectiles.
bullets: Clean ground is more valuable than maximum uptime.
Keep the boss on-screen while clearing mercenaries.
One safe rotation after a slam is the repeatable damage window.

sections.title: Build-specific adjustments
paragraphs: Slow attacks and long casts should begin only after the axe lands. Minion or companion builds must keep the player moving while the summon attacks; do not stand behind the companion in the frontal lane.
If the fight lasts too long, first check weapon damage, main-skill level, compatible supports and resource sustain. More buttons are not automatically more single-target damage.
bullets: Minions: preserve player visibility and recovery.
Grenades or delayed skills: place them where the boss will finish the animation.

problems.symptom: The red attack keeps killing me
checks: Stop retreating along the attack line.
Wait for the aim commitment, then move laterally.
Keep the arena edge behind the boss rather than behind the character.
directAnswer: The reliable answer is sideways movement after target lock.

checks: Use a compact area skill on ranged mercenaries.
Keep circling so the boss remains visible.
Do not chase harmless melee adds across the arena.
directAnswer: Remove ranged pressure first, then resume boss damage.

problems.symptom: I run out of flask or mana
checks: Use safe recovery windows instead of attacking continuously.
directAnswer: Sustainable damage wins this fight more reliably than one expensive burst.

checks: Bait the overhead slam at medium range.
Cross behind after the weapon commits.
Use one short combo and leave before the sweep.
directAnswer: The slam recovery is the primary melee window.

entries.question: The red line attack keeps killing me
summary: Players retreat along the attack line and get caught by the full strike.
editorialAnalysis: The line is a committed frontal attack; lateral movement after lock is the fix, not backing away.
officialAnswer: Leave the frontal lane sideways once the red aim commits; never walk back along the line.

entries.question: Mercenaries overwhelm the arena
summary: Ranged adds stack damage while the boss keeps swinging.
editorialAnalysis: Ranged pressure blocks movement and hides the axe tell.
officialAnswer: Kill ranged mercenaries first while circling so the boss stays visible.

entries.question: Melee cannot find an opening
summary: Players trade hits during the sweep instead of using recovery.
editorialAnalysis: The slam recovery is the only safe melee window.
officialAnswer: Bait the overhead, cross behind after lock, use one short combo, then leave.

items.question: Is fire resistance mandatory?
answer: The main weapon threat is physical, but fire resistance helps when ground effects and mercenaries overlap; use it if fire is the repeated cause of death.

items.question: Should I kill every add?
answer: Kill ranged or movement-blocking mercenaries first. Do not lose boss visibility chasing a low-threat add.

items.question: Where is the safest place to stand?
answer: At medium range with room to move sideways and without the arena wall directly behind you.

items.question: What is the best damage window?
answer: The long recovery after an overhead or committed line attack.

items.question: What should I do after the kill?
answer: Free Leitis, collect the quest reward, and confirm The Trail of Corruption updated.
